name: create-draft
description: Saves a plain-text email as a Gmail draft; nothing is sent (gmail__send-email sends at once). With a threadId from gmail__search-messages the draft is a reply to that conversation’s newest message and takes the conversation’s subject.

to.description: One recipient address or several separated by commas.

subject.description: Email subject. Needed without a threadId; with one, the conversation’s subject is used.

cc.description: Optional CC addresses separated by commas.

bcc.description: Optional BCC addresses separated by commas.

threadId.description: Optional conversation thread ID from gmail__search-messages; the draft replies to its newest message.
